items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: A lot of those ballads I guess he wrote for Johnny Hodges

ctx.x: That was a trademark of the Ellington band almost, is that he wrote for certain people, not just the second alto player, you know. He wrote for the individual I think.

A lot of those ballads I guess he wrote for Johnny Hodges, later on people put lyrics to them and they became pop songs. “Don’t Get Around Much Anymore” — actually the melody of that was a little different when he first wrote it, but they changed it around.
